gym.name: POWER FITNESS
gym.punchlineMeaning: The harder you grind, the stronger you get.
gym.tagline: Train hard. Stay strong. Live powerful.
gym.about: POWER FITNESS is a no-excuses strength gym built for people who want real results. Whether you are lifting for the first time or chasing a new personal record, you get serious equipment, certified coaches and a crew that pushes you to show up every single day.
story: POWER FITNESS started with a simple belief: results come from consistent, honest hard work, not shortcuts. We built a gym where beginners feel welcome on day one and experienced lifters have the equipment and coaching to keep progressing.
Today our members train across strength, cardio, weight training and group classes, with coaches who know every member by name and track every rep that matters.
gym.announcement: First time here? Your trial workout is FREE.

values.title: Discipline
values.text: Show up, do the work, repeat. Discipline beats motivation every single time.

values.title: Strength
values.text: We build bodies that are strong, capable and ready for real life, not just for the mirror.

values.title: Community
values.text: Train next to people who cheer for your PRs and notice when you miss a day.

highlights: Certified coaches on the floor at all hours
Free fitness assessment when you join
Diet guidance built around home-cooked food
Clean, air-conditioned and safe for everyone

perks.title: Free trial
perks.text: Your first workout is on us

quotes.text: The weight does not care about your excuses.

trainers.name: Coach Adithya
trainers.title: Founder & Coach
trainers.quote: Every rep you don't want to do is the rep that builds you. Raghdo aaj, chamko kal.
trainers.bio: Adithya founded POWER FITNESS and still coaches on the floor every day. He leads our HIIT and conditioning classes and specialises in fat loss, core strength and bodyweight training.

trainers.name: Coach Naveed
trainers.title: Head Coach
trainers.quote: Discipline builds freedom. Show up on the days you don't feel like it — those are the days that change you.
trainers.bio: Naveed runs the strength floor. He coaches the big lifts with strict technique and writes progressive plans that keep members adding weight to the bar month after month.

trainers.name: Coach Shazan
trainers.title: Assistant Coach
trainers.quote: Show up, do the basics brilliantly, and the results will follow.
trainers.bio: Shazan supports members across the training floor, helping beginners with form, setting up workouts and running our core and mobility sessions.

trainers.name: Coach Rohit
trainers.title: Coach
trainers.quote: Strong arms, stronger mindset. Train with intent every single rep.
trainers.bio: Rohit coaches strength and bodybuilding. He focuses on upper-body development, good posture and steady progressive overload, and makes sure every member trains with correct form.

trainers.name: Coach Geetha
trainers.title: Ladies Coach
trainers.quote: Strong is beautiful. Lift with confidence and own every rep.
trainers.bio: Geetha leads our ladies batch and Zumba classes. She helps women build strength, tone up and train confidently in a comfortable, supportive space.

facilities.title: Cardio Deck
facilities.text: Treadmills, cross-trainers, spin bikes and rowers with heart-rate tracking.

facilities.title: Functional Zone

facilities.title: Diet & Nutrition

facilities.title: Lockers & Showers
facilities.text: Secure lockers, clean changing rooms and hot water showers.

facilities.title: Parking & RO Water
facilities.text: Free two-wheeler and car parking plus RO drinking water on the floor.

programs.title: Strength Training

testimonials.name: Sneha Kulkarni
testimonials.text: I joined after my second baby and honestly was scared to walk into a gym. The ladies batch at 11 was perfect for me. Coach Geetha started me with light weights and never made me feel awkward. Down 9 kg in 5 months and I can finally do proper push-ups!

testimonials.name: Rahul Deshmukh
testimonials.text: Proper equipment, proper bars, plates don't wobble. My deadlift went from 80 to 140 kg here. It gets crowded between 7 and 8 pm, so I shifted to mornings, but the staff manage the rush well.

testimonials.name: Imran Shaikh
testimonials.text: I'm 46 with a desk job and had lower back pain for years. Instead of throwing me into heavy lifting, they started with mobility and core work. Six months later I'm squatting without pain. Wish I had come earlier.

testimonials.name: Priya Mehta
testimonials.text: Adithya's HIIT and Geetha's evening Zumba are the best part of my day. High energy, good music, and the changing room is actually clean, which matters a lot.

testimonials.name: Aditya Joshi
testimonials.text: Good value for money. The yearly plan works out to about ₹1,000 a month and the trainers actually check your form. Only complaint is parking fills up on weekend evenings.

testimonials.name: Neha Rao
testimonials.text: As a college student the fees are reasonable. The diet chart they gave me uses normal home food like dal, roti, paneer and eggs, nothing fancy. Already seeing a difference in my energy.

faqs.q: Is the trial session really free?
faqs.a: Yes. First-time visitors get one free guided workout and a body assessment. Book it on the Free Trial page or just call us.

faqs.q: I have never been to a gym. Is POWER FITNESS right for me?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Most of our members started as beginners. A coach will teach you the basics, set the right weights and build a plan around your level.

faqs.q: What should I bring for my first visit?
faqs.a: Comfortable workout clothes, clean indoor shoes, a towel and a water bottle. Lockers are available.
A one-time registration fee of ₹500 applies to all plans.
Half-Yearly members can freeze for up to 15 days and Yearly members for up to 30 days, for travel, illness or exams.
Payment happens only after your free trial. Pay at the front desk after meeting us (UPI, card or cash), or directly on WhatsApp. There is no online payment on the website.

faqs.q: Can I upgrade my plan later?
faqs.a: Yes. You only pay the difference for the remaining period when you upgrade.

faqs.q: Are group classes included in membership?
faqs.a: Quarterly plans include one class a week. Half-Yearly and Yearly plans include unlimited classes. Book your spot on the Classes page.

faqs.q: Do you have a ladies-only batch?
faqs.a: Yes. Coach Geetha runs our Ladies Strength batch, Monday to Saturday from 11:00 AM to 1:00 PM.

faqs.q: How much does personal training cost?
faqs.a: Personal training is an add-on starting from ₹3,000 per month. Yearly members get 2 sessions included.

timingsNote: Ladies batch with Coach Geetha: 11:00 AM – 1:00 PM, Monday to Saturday.
